title: Salora Glam
tagline: Salon & Spa Billing and Management Software
cardDescription: Salon and spa management with appointments, customers, service catalogue, staff, billing and sales records.
overview: Salora Glam helps beauty and wellness businesses run day-to-day operations from one digital platform: appointments, customers, services, staff and billing.
problem: Salons manage bookings by phone and paper, which leads to double bookings, lost customer history and manual billing.
solution: A management app with appointment booking, a service and price catalogue, customer profiles, staff management and quick invoice generation.
result: Salons organise appointments and billing digitally and keep a complete history of every customer's services.

challenges.challenge: Avoiding double-booked staff and time slots.
challenges.solution: Appointments are tied to staff and time so conflicts are visible while booking.
